I hope that you'll continue to enjoy Beau & Bow!

Happy Anniversary Beau & Bow!

notes.title: Beau & Bow II? When?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today marks four years since my first project was released online. Today also marks two years since the originally intended launch date of Beau & Bow was missed. In a way, it's like Beau & Bow's birthday as well. Even though the characters go back way further, but that's another story...

Since the release of Beau & Bow I have continued to hone my craft. That is to say, I've worked on a number of projects. These included a 3D platformer, a top-down dungeon crawler, and a roguelike. I'd like to say that you'll see these projects soon, but they all fell through.

I realize now that I enjoy making 2D platformers the most. 2D platformers with cute things in them. Things like bunny sweethearts and balloons with little blushing faces. Which has me thinking...

Beau & Bow II?

When?

Soon.

notes.title: Happy Easter To Every Bunny!
notes.notes:
Happy Easter To Every Bunny!

Audio Update:
Pausing now gives the option to control both music and sound effects. 
Use your arrow keys when paused. Right and left to control volume, up and down to change between music and sound effects.

Note:
The credits default the music to the default volume.
Continuing the game after the credits does not reset the sound effect volume.

Thank you for your continued support of Beau & Bow!

Thank you for supporting Beau & Bow!

notes.title: Surprise! More improvements are here!
notes.notes:
Hello again everyone, I’m here with more changes!


QoL:
Made it so you have to use start/enter to change from the title/bonus screens, instead of being able to use jump or the camera button. This way the player doesn’t accidentally skip past the bonus information stage at the end of the game. It will now be harder to miss-click when inputting a password as well.

Passwords are now harder to brute force.

Passwords work on the splash screen, controls screen, and title screen.

If using a color filter, it will now persist after having a game over or when beating the game by default.

The movement speed on the first boss has been slowed from 15, 30, 45 pixels a second to 12, 24, and 36.

The first boss now has a slightly taller scan area.


Bug Fixes:
Password #1 & #2 now work more consistently.

Fixed a minor issue where the color filter could not be changed off of the one in use without trying another color code first. This happened after beating the game.

Fixed a bug that caused the top few layers of the head of the first boss to shift to the right by a pixel or two during the upset animation before hunkering. This did not impact any collisions, it was only a graphical issue. Since updating the speed values, I have not been able to recreate this bug.


Know Issues:
Would you have guessed that it’s related to Bow? Bow will become stuck in some ceilings if thrown and switched to at the right time. To fix this, simply hit the camera button again, this will disable her larger collision-box and cause her to drop down.

The screen still flickers white for a fraction of a second on occasion when changing levels. I have several ideas on what’s causing this. For now, it’s just a minor and nearly random, but not truly random inconvenience.

If you are experiencing any bugs or issues, please let me know. I will do what I can to help.


Thank you everyone for continuing to support Beau & Bow!

notes.title: It's always after the test that you remember what to do.
notes.notes:
Have you ever realized the solution to a problem as soon as you left a classroom? 
Well, that's how I felt a few moments ago. But that's good! That means we can have another update! 
Beau & Bow Birthday Lunar New Year Update #2!



Bug fixes:
I found the source of the known audio problem. Some levels had an older audio check active alongside a newer audio check. This caused a hiccup where the first note would be played twice when starting that level. The problem should be fixed for good now, but if you happen across it, let me know.

There was also a new oversight found when finishing the game and starting a new game. The player would retain their old health and number of continues from the final boss level. This has now been fixed.

Extra Information:
I forgot to mention that I moved a few NPCs, and I updated the terrain at the end of the first level.



As always, thank you for your continued support of Beau & Bow!

notes.title: Year Of The Rabbit & One Month Update!
notes.notes:
I'd like to take this moment to wish everyone a very Happy Year Of The Rabbit!
It has also been a month since Beau & Bow was released. 
Thank you everyone for the support & Happy 1st Month Birthday Beau & Bow!



Major Changes:

Passwords.
You can now skip to bridge levels, the levels found after a boss. Copy the code found on the sign in these levels and input it on the title screen. After that, press enter/start and like magic you're at that stage!

Secrets.
Some players found the secret color change, but not as many as I had hoped. Now, when you beat the game, a new screen will illustrate how to change between the secret color shaders. I also added two new color shaders for this update.


Fixes:

Bow.
Improved collisions with walls and ceilings. She should no longer go into a crouch when jumping straight up into a ceiling.

Fade in & fade out.
The fade in and out is now quicker, and the issue with the momentary flicker when loading into a level should be fixed. The fade in and out will now match the color of the filter being used, instead of always being white.


Know Issues:

Audio.
An audio bug sometimes occurs when loading a level. It causes the first note of a song to play twice.



Thank you again for your support and interest in Beau & Bow! 
Have a Happy Lunar New Year and a hopping good time with this update!

notes.title: Do you hear what I hear? An audio update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I hope that you're enjoying the end of the year with friends, family, and games. Speaking of games, this one has an update. I hope that you like it!

Main Changes:
Pausing the game now gives the option to change the music volume. The volume indicator is found between the health icon and the continue icon when paused.
Jumping & Springs now have pitch variance to spare your ears the same sound again and again.

Bug fixes:
Fixed an audio issue where the first note of the Beach level song played twice when entering the stage.
Fixed Bow becoming stuck when attempting to stand up out of a crouch near the edge of a crawling space.

Quality of life:
Moved a few NPCs on the third stage of the Beach level.
Moved the secret spot on the final stage of the Castle level.
Updated the default resolution to be 640x576, up from the original 160x144.

Extra Information:
You can always change the resolution by manually dragging the game window. That or you can be more precise by following this Steam guide.

To set your own custom resolution, follow this guide:
1. Right click Beau & Bow in your Steam Library.
2. Go to the General tab and click the Set launch options button.
3. Type in your custom resolution.
4. Close the window and enjoy your game!

As an example, the original resolution of a certain handheld gaming device from the '80s:
-screen-width 160 -screen-height 144

As always, thank you for your continued support of Beau & Bow!

notes.title: Merry Christmas! Here's some fixes.
notes.notes:
You might have noticed a number of updates these past few days. 
I've been fixing bugs and working on issues brought up by the community. 
For everyone's sake, I chose not to spam patch notes twice a day for half a week. 
Here's a list of what has been done since launch.



Bug fixes:
Fixed the platform bug mentioned in the first patch notes.
Fixed a bug linked to the secret colors, caused by the colors overlapping each other.
NPC moved on Beach Stage Level I to prevent a known gravity bug.
Fixed, at least I hope, a bug where both characters can move at the same time.

Cosmetic changes:
Changed a few background tiles in a hat level towards the end of the game.
Moved a few grass sprites and flower sprites.

Quality of life:
Secret skips added to Grass Level II & Grass Level III.
Added a screen after the joke splash screen that explains the controls for PC.
Reworked the collisions on several NPCs to be more forgiving.
Fixed a softlock on Grass Stage Level II.
Fixed a softlock where the player could run and fall off-screen on Grass Stage Level I.



If you are experiencing any bugs or issues, please let me know. I will do what I can to help.

Thank you everyone for continuing to support Beau & Bow!

Merry Christmas & Happy New Year!
